$comment: Outcome and error code meanings are listed in contracts/domain-vocabulary.json. Canonical structured error pointer (plan §3.4): the error code of a command response is at the RFC6901 pointer /error/code relative to the response object. Acceptance cases read it as /response/error/code for api/mcp invoke and for await of an invoked command, and as /response/body/result/structuredContent/error/code for a raw MCP wire result. /errorCode, /code and other top-level code fields are not part of this contract.

code.$comment: Structured code such as TYPE_INVALID, VERSION_UNSUPPORTED, POLICY_UNRESOLVED, FORBIDDEN, STALE_REVISION, IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, INSUFFICIENT_ELIGIBLE_QUANTITY or EVIDENCE_CONFLICT (plan §3.4). It must not reveal secrets or other organizations' identifiers.
